texts.title: Once off text for the change from Limited Coast Assigned to Limited Coast Assigned System
texts.text: Prior to 4 September 2002 this licence authorised the operation of one Limited Coast Assigned Station.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to limited coast assigned stations.
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Limited Coast Assigned System authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Maritime Coast Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: No interference / no protection
texts.text: No interference shall be caused to any Radiocommunication station or service and no protection from interference by such stations or services shall be afforded.

texts.title: Emergency or stand-by operation
texts.text: The station shall be operated under the direction and control of the parent station licensee and then only during maintenance of the main installation or when the main installation is out of order or rendered inoperative or when the main installation is not being staffed.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to limited coast marine rescue stations.
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Limited Coast Marine Rescue station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Maritime Coast Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Exemption granted for assisting an exempt body.
texts.text: A transmitter may only be operated under this licence for the sole or principal purpose of assisting a body to which subregulation 5(7) or 5(8) of the Radiocommunications Taxes Collection Regulations apply.

texts.title: Safety-only - no fee for service
texts.text: The safety service provided by this station must be available to all users on a nil-fee-for-service basis.

texts.title: Repeater access
texts.text: Access to the repeater station must be provided on an unrestricted basis to any licensee in the service.

texts.title: Repeater access limited to 1 minute
texts.text: A facility limiting access to no more than 1 minute must be activated in the repeater by each transmission.

texts.title: Charges/continuous service/transmission restriction
texts.text: 1. The station must produce a continuous service. 2. No charges may be imposed by the licensee or their agent for the use of the repeater facility. 3. No transmission shall be made in the absence of a received signal. The transmitter must not be able to lock-on due to a malfunction.

texts.title: Low power open narrowcasting
texts.text: This licence can only be used to provide a low-power open narrowcasting service.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to narrowcasting service stations.
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Narrowcasting Service station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Broadcasting Licence) Determination.  Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Malfunction / interference
texts.text: In the event of a malfunction or interference being caused to other services, termination of transmissions must be promptly effected. Where access to the repeater is difficult, termination of transmissions must be achievable by remote switching.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to ambulatory system stations
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Ambulatory System station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Land Mobile Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Conditions applicable to narrowband area service stations.
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Narrowband Area Service station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Broadcasting Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Interference management
texts.text: The licensee must ensure that no harmful interference shall be caused to the operation of any radiocommunication station or service. If the operation of the transmitter is causing interference to other services, the licensee is required, at the licensee's own expense, to adjust, or fit devices to, receivers in order to eliminate or minimise that interference.
The original location of the Low Power Open Narrowcast (LPON) service authorised by this licence is (AMG66 Datum) Z55, E476825, N7860960

texts.title: Transmissions in the Land Mobile and Fixed bands 29.7 - 520 MHz
texts.text: The level of all discreet spurious components, measured at the output of the transmitter, must not exceed -30dBm.

texts.title: Transmissions in the Land Mobile and Fixed bands 29.7 - 520 MHz with 12.5 kHz separation
texts.text: The level of power in the adjacent channel must not exceed -16dBm.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to point to point stations.
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Point to Point station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Fixed Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Cavity filter - transceiver/antenna
texts.text: An efficient cavity filter must be fitted between the transceiver and the antenna.
This licence issued fee exempt on condition that the apparatus is used principally in support of the Australian Volunteer Coast Guard, Ku-ring-gai Flotilla, in search and rescue operations.
Station Location:  AVCGA Headquarters, Luff St, Hull Heads, Qld.

texts.title: Responsibility of licensee to advertise in newspaper before commencement of a broadcasting or narrowcasting service.  Use instead of NA.
texts.text: The licensee, or any authorised person, is required to place advertisements in newspapers circulating within the licence area of the licence at least seven days before the commencement of transmissions. The advertisement should state that members of the public should contact the licensee, or authorised person, if the broadcast causes interference to other radiocommunications. The advertisement must detail the date and the time of the commencement of transmissions, the frequency being used and the appropriate person's contact details, including the address and telephone number of the person responsible for the transmissions.

texts.title: Licence issued for the drop through period only
texts.text: This licence is issued or renewed only for the period for which the frequency has been made available under section 34 of the Broadcasting Services Act 1992.

texts.title: Responsibility of licensee, regarding transmitter interference. Replaced by KC in March 1997.
texts.text: The licensee is required to place advertisments in newspapers circulating within the coverage area of the transmitter, within 7 days of the commencement of operations, or changes to operation conditions of the transmitter, asking members of the public to contact the licensee if they believe that operation of the transmitter is causing interference to another service.

texts.title: Received signal - residential area
texts.text: The received signal in any area zoned residential (as determined by the Australian Bureau of Statistics data for towns and cities) shall not exceed 48 DBUV/M measured at a height of 10 metres above ground at any location more than 2 km from the antenna.

texts.title: Maximum antenna height
texts.text: The effective antenna height above average terrain shall not exceed 10 metres.

texts.title: Conditions applicable to amateur repeater stations
texts.text: Conditions applicable to the operation of Amateur Repeater station(s) authorised under this licence can be found in the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Transmitter Licence) Determination and the Radiocommunications Licence Conditions (Amateur Licence) Determination. Copies of these determinations are available from the ACMA and from the Federal Register of Legislation (www.legislation.gov.au).

texts.title: Conditions applicable to point to multipoint stations (Refer also ANFB2 PTMP Land Mob Spec)
